{{Quote|He invited them to his palace on Nathema, built on the site of his childhood home, the place where he had killed his adopted father and tortured his mother to death.|Darth Nyriss|<ref name="Revan" />}}
Upon ascending to the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in [[5100 BBY/Legends|5100 BBY]], [[5107 BBY|seven years]] after he [[Death/Legends|killed]] his [[Tenebrae's mother|mother]] and [[Tenebrae's adoptive father|father]] and embarked on a [[Medriaas revolution|campaign]] to conquer the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema|Medriaas]], the teenage [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] ordered the construction of a '''palace''' on the site of his childhood home in a [[Tenebrae's village|village]]. He ruled Medriaas, which he renamed Nathema, from his palace for the next century until the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] between the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when he summoned the remaining Sith Lords of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] to his palace and forced the eight thousand who answered his call to participate in a [[Ritual of Nathema|dark side ritual]]. After the completion of the ritual and the subsequent [[Death/Legends|death]] of every living thing on the planet, the palace was abandoned along with the rest of the world when Vitiate departed Nathema and became the Sith Emperor. The Sith Lord [[Darth Nyriss]] would later mention the palace while describing the Emperor's history to Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] in [[3954 BBY]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vitiate's palace was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', during an explanation of the Sith Emperor's history by Darth Nyriss.<ref name="Revan" />
